name: web-next
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: Web app with Next.js
description: A full Next.js app (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind and shadcn/ui) ready to grow: add auth, a database, payments, email or AI from the catalog.
instructions:
## How to work here

- App Router: routes, layouts and route handlers live in `src/app/`. Components are Server Components by default; add `"use client"` only where you need state, effects or browser APIs, and keep those components small.
- Read data in Server Components and change it with Server Actions; validate every input on the server.
- UI comes from shadcn/ui (`src/components/ui/`); shared pieces go in `src/components/` and pure helpers in `src/lib/`.
- Secrets only in `.env.local` and only on the server: never prefix them with `NEXT_PUBLIC_`.
- Before finishing a task: `npm run lint` and `npm run build`.
